
  // (type type)
  public class Type_type {
    var p_any : Vx_Core.Type_any!
    var type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic!
    var p_path : String
    var p_pkgname : String
    var p_name : String
    var p_alias : String
    var p_idx : Int
    var p_extends : Vx_Core.Type_string!
    var p_empty : Vx_Core.Type_any!
    var p_propertymap : Vx_Core.Type_varmap!
    var p_container : Vx_Core.Type_type!
    var p_allowtypes : Vx_Core.Type_typelist!
    var p_func : Vx_Core.Type_func!
    var p_isnative : Bool
    var p_prefix : String
    public init() {}
  }

  // v_constructor_type
  public static func v_constructor_type(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    Vx_Core.v_reserve_global()
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.Type_type()
    return output
  }

  // v_create_type
  public static func v_create_type(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_constructor_type()
    Vx_Core.v_initialize_type(
      output)
    return output
  }

  // v_initialize_type
  public static func v_initialize_type(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_type
  ) {
    value.p_any = Vx_Core.v_any_from_type_backref(
      Vx_Core.t_type,
      value)
    value.type_generic = Vx_Core.e_generic
    value.p_path = ""
    value.p_pkgname = ""
    value.p_name = ""
    value.p_alias = ""
    value.p_idx = 0
    value.p_extends = Vx_Core.e_string
    value.p_empty = Vx_Core.e_any
    value.p_propertymap = Vx_Core.e_varmap
    value.p_container = Vx_Core.e_type
    value.p_allowtypes = Vx_Core.e_typelist
    value.p_func = Vx_Core.e_func
    value.p_isnative = false
    value.p_prefix = ""
  }

  // v_release_type
  public static func v_release_type(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_type
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    if value !== Vx_Core.e_type {
      Vx_Core.v_release_any(
        value.p_any)
    }
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.e_type
    return output
  }

  // v_reserve_type
  public static func v_reserve_type(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_type
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    Vx_Core.v_reserve_any(
      value.p_any)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = value
    return output
  }

  // v_shutdown_type
  public static func v_shutdown_type(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_type
  ) {
    value.type_generic = Vx_Core.v_release_generic(
      value.type_generic)
    value.p_path = ""
    value.p_pkgname = ""
    value.p_name = ""
    value.p_alias = ""
    value.p_idx = 0
    value.p_extends = Vx_Core.v_release_string(
      value.p_extends)
    value.p_empty = Vx_Core.v_release_any(
      value.p_empty)
    value.p_propertymap = Vx_Core.v_release_varmap(
      value.p_propertymap)
    value.p_container = Vx_Core.e_type
    value.p_allowtypes = Vx_Core.v_release_typelist(
      value.p_allowtypes)
    value.p_func = Vx_Core.v_release_func(
      value.p_func)
    value.p_isnative = false
    value.p_prefix = ""
    Vx_Core.v_shutdown_any(
      value.p_any)
    Vx_Core.v_release_global()
  }

  // v_startup_type
  public static func v_startup_type(
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    var t_variable : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.t_type
    var e_variable : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.e_type
    Vx_Core.v_initialize_type(
      e_variable)
    Vx_Core.v_type_t_startup(
      t_variable,
      "vx/core",
      "type",
      "type",
      Vx_Core.e_string,
      e_variable.p_any)
    t_variable.p_propertymap = Vx_Core.v_varmap_from_listvar(
      [
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_private_from_namen_type(
          "type-generic",
          Vx_Core.t_generic),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "path",
          Vx_Core.t_stringn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "pkgname",
          Vx_Core.t_stringn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "name",
          Vx_Core.t_stringn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "alias",
          Vx_Core.t_stringn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "idx",
          Vx_Core.t_intn),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "extends",
          Vx_Core.t_string),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "empty",
          Vx_Core.t_any),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "propertymap",
          Vx_Core.t_varmap),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "container",
          Vx_Core.t_type),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "allowtypes",
          Vx_Core.t_typelist),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "func",
          Vx_Core.t_func),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "isnative",
          Vx_Core.t_booleann),
        Vx_Core.v_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
          "prefix",
          Vx_Core.t_stringn)
      ])
    var type_generic : Vx_Core.Type_generic = Vx_Core.v_create_generic()
    type_generic.p_copy_funcn = Vx_Core.a_copy_type
    type_generic.p_new_funcn = Vx_Core.a_new_type
    t_variable.type_generic = type_generic
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = t_variable
    return output
  }

  // v_cast_type
  public static func v_cast_type(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.e_type
    if type_any.p_type === Vx_Core.t_type {
      output = unsafeBitCast(type_any.backref, to: Vx_Core.Type_type.self)
    }
    return output
  }

  // a_cast_type
  public static func a_cast_type(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_type
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // v_clone_type
  public static func v_clone_type(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_type
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    var output : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_create_type()
    return output
  }

  // v_copy_type
  public static func v_copy_type(
    _ value : Vx_Core.Type_type,
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.e_type
    return output
  }

  // a_copy_type
  public static func a_copy_type(
    _ type_any : Vx_Core.Type_any,
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_cast_type(
      type_any)
    let copy_value : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_copy_type(
      value,
      type_anylist)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = copy_value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // v_new_type
  public static func v_new_type(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_copy_type(
      Vx_Core.e_type,
      type_anylist)
    return output
  }

  // a_new_type
  public static func a_new_type(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_any {
    let value : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_new_type(
      type_anylist)
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_any = value.p_any
    return output
  }

  // f_type
  public static func f_type(
    _ type_anylist : Vx_Core.Type_anylist
  ) -> Vx_Core.Type_type {
    let output : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_new_type(
      type_anylist)
    return output
  }

  public static let t_type : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_constructor_type()
  public static let e_type : Vx_Core.Type_type = Vx_Core.v_constructor_type()
